$source: Hand-kept craft recipes that the NEU repo lacks, read by scripts/build-data.ts and merged into catalog.recipes when NEU has no recipe for the output. Craft chains (src/domain/chains.ts) and the Craft view use them like any NEU recipe.
$policy: Add a recipe only after checking it in game or on a current wiki page, and put that page in `source`. Entries are skipped (with a warning) once NEU ships a recipe for the same output.
